patthana15.63:1.1: Kāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanakāmāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Nakāmāvacaraṃ kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanakāmāvacaro nakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā dve.
patthana15.63:2.1: Kāmāvacaraṃ akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca nanakāmāvacaro naakusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. Hetuyā ekaṃ. (Abyākatamūlaṃ dve.)
